Package dev.relism.flash.ext.view.thymeleaf

Class ThymeleafModule

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.view.core.ViewModule
dev.relism.flash.ext.view.thymeleaf.ThymeleafModule
All Implemented Interfaces:
Module
public final class ThymeleafModule extends ViewModule
Thymeleaf templates for ViewHandlers named with Template or Fragment, read from the classpath. Globals are under global: ${global.user}. Templates are cached outside dev.
